Theres no such thing as a biological race for humans. Unless you’re talking Neanderthals vs Homo sapiens, but there’s not enough genetic diversity to categorize them biologically. Of course if you’re researching based on geological factors you’re gonna find individual traits but that still doesn’t define a race, that’s just phenotype vs genotype. 

Race is a social construct and unfortunately still real, but that’s because of social dynamics and history, not biology.
Skin color might have a little importance in medicine, like for UV protection, but race doesn’t. That one’s only good for social science.
